in_arabic.name: عليزة
in_arabic.meaning: المرأة العالية في الشرف و الرفعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عليزة مشتق من العلو و الرفعة، و هو يعني المرأة التي تتمتع بشرف و رفعة عالية، و هي تعبر عن القوة و العزة في الشخصية، و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و رفيعة في الثقافة الإسلامية و العربية.

in_urdu.name: علیزہ
in_urdu.meaning: عالی شرف والی، بلند کردار والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: علیزہ نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے شرف والی، بلند کردار والی۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں عزت و سربلندی کی علامت ہے، اور جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان معاشرے میں بھی اس کا خوب استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलीज़ा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलीज़ा नाम का अर्थ उच्च चरित्र वाली और सम्मानित महिला होता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी इसका उपयोग किया जाता है। यह नाम उच्च नैतिक मूल्यों और आत्म-सम्मान को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: عليزه
in_pashto.meaning: د عزت لرونکی، د لوړ شخصیت لرونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عليزه نوم د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د عزت لرونکی او د لوړ شخصیت لرونکی دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره سم دی، او د اسلامي کلتور په منځ کې د پام وړ دی.

in_english.name: Alizah
in_english.meaning: Noble woman, one with high character and honor
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alizah originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the term 'Ali', meaning 'high' or 'exalted', and 'zah', suggesting 'noble' or 'blooming'. It signifies a woman of high character, nobility, and honor. In Islamic tradition, the name Alizah reflects the values of strength, dignity, and spiritual elevation. Historically, names derived from Arabic roots have been significant in Muslim cultures worldwide, symbolizing virtues and positive attributes. The name Alizah is associated with personality traits such as leadership, compassion, and a strong sense of justice.

pronunciation.urdu: علیزہ کا تلفظ علی زہ ہے
pronunciation.hindi: अलीज़ा का उच्चारण अली ज़ा है
pronunciation.pashto: د عليزه تلفظ د ah-LIE-zah په شان دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Alizah carries a distinct cultural significance in the Islamic world, as it is derived from the Arabic language. It is often given to children as a symbol of their noble and esteemed lineage, tracing back to the Prophet Muhammad and the rich Islamic heritage. Moreover, the name comes from the Arabic root "alaza," which means "to raise" or "to exalt," reflecting traditional Islamic values of achievement, empowerment, and social mobility.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Alizah also holds deep spiritual significance in Islam. It represents the idea of spiritual elevation and the striving for higher consciousness and understanding of God. As Muslims believe in continuous personal growth towards closeness to Allah, Alizah can be seen as an inspiration for individuals to maintain their faith and seek higher levels of spiritual fulfillment. Furthermore, the name can be linked to the concept of Al-'Alim, the All-Knowing, All-Aware God, who lifts up and enlightens those who seek knowledge and wisdom.
